criteria_rationale: 20 mm outside the target height band is a minimum software regression gate to catch the observed 118/149 mm excursions, not a hardware safety clearance. Whole-record unshifted position error must not exceed recorded baseline by more than 5 mm, preventing slower interpolation from masquerading as a path fix. Passing this case alone is not release acceptance.
required_followup: Physical Gazebo replay of the complete recording, including low-height sideways movement, return motion and wrist changes.
Actual stopping, reversal and overshoot; latest feedback 100 ms, source reference 120 ms and all existing guards.
Compare delay without time shifting, slowing playback or skipping targets; include A/IK/input timing in a separate full-loop test.
limitations: Offline replay uses recorded IK goals; it does not re-solve IK or model closed-loop feedback.
Physical reference derivatives are not guaranteed by software reference limits.
Full raw input, submitted actions, measured feedback and events remain in the evidence archive.
